blocks.content: Your streaming platform is analyzing movie rankings, and your manager notices something unusual:
"I see that movies with the same rating share a rank, but the next rank is skipped. Can we assign ranks without gaps?"
To fix this, you can use DENSE_RANK(), which works like RANK() but ensures that ranks increase sequentially, even for ties.
Use this space for your doubts about this lesson. Ask us anything that's confusing and our experts will provide explanations to help you understand.
